start_scene_0_3s.description: ScanWatch hypnogram showing frequent nighttime awakenings.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Shows how mask leaks or high pressure trigger micro-arousals.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Suggests checking mask fit and bedroom sleep hygiene.

en.full_narration: Your sleep looked more interrupted than usual. Using your CPAP all night may help, and persistent changes should be discussed with your provider.
